effects.display_name: Dodge Roll native charges and recovery
effects.human_summary: Dodge Roll native charges and recovery; static native semantics, runtime untested.
effects.stage_reason: Fixed native resource/control/admission; no numeric HP/SHP payload to scale.
actual_behavior: Native client rising-edge Dodge Roll key (default keycode90) sends DodgeRollMessage(type0,left,forward) and calls local pressAction for prediction. Registered payload handler processes only SERVERBOUND, queues work with context.player (no arbitrary target player), then pressAction. Actual server pressAction requires nonempty current chunk, type0, config CAN_USE_ROLL true, not swimming, an available charge with cooldown<=0, and successful startRoll. startRoll independently requires roll<=-5 and onGround. No native spectator/creative/gear/boss-presence predicate is added here. Native registered networking and event annotations are pinned; actual runtime delivery/sync is untested.

Constructor starts roll0, duration14, no charge entries. PlayerTickEvent.Post calls tick; every tick charge capacity is max(0, configured DEFAULT_ROLL_COUNT + integer ROLL_COUNT attribute). Default capacity2, native syncable attribute default0 range0..9. Newly added slots start0; removed slots are removeLast after prior sorting. Successful start resets rollDuration14 and roll14, then caller sets used cooldown1 and sorts. isRolling is roll>0; isInvulnerable is strictly roll>7, i.e. counter values14..8 only. Counter decrements one per Post until-5, including5tick recovery after roll0. These are method counter windows, not a promise of wall-clock invulnerability independent of event order.

Only when roll already<=-5 does tick subtract1/ROLL_COOLDOWN from the first positive cooldown and stop; charge recovery is sequential, paused through active roll/recovery. Default configured40; negative config sets firstpositive0, zero uses native float division (no added clamp). ROLL_COOLDOWN_MORE default20 exists but has zero GETSTATIC consumers anywhere in installed artifact, so do not invent per-extra-charge delay. Charges/duration/cooldown are native resources with no Stage value. Equipment ROLL_COUNT producers are indexed for later equipment review; no uncalled attribute helper is promoted as a working delivery.

Only other installed direct RollAttachment.isInvulnerable consumer is Yeti GlacialShove: ServerPlayer in its native zone is skipped while roll>7. That is a separate explicit displacement/status gate, not evidence ordinary knockback is canceled everywhere; full Yeti producer/geometry is pending. Attachment serialization retains direction,duration,roll,count and each cooldown; registry uses AttachmentType.serializable. Do not synthesize/clear saved state. Death-copy/synchronization behavior is not assumed from serialization alone.

effects.display_name: Dodge Roll native movement and control
effects.human_summary: Dodge Roll native movement and control; static native semantics, runtime untested.
effects.stage_reason: Fixed native resource/control/admission; no numeric HP/SHP payload to scale.
actual_behavior: startRoll forces CROUCHING; move normalizes existing horizontal velocity plus desired input and sets horizontal magnitude MOVEMENT_SPEED *6*(10/rollDuration), retaining vertical velocity and marking impulse. Direction selected from dominant input with forward fallback, orientation aligned with head. During rolling, tick clears shift and repeats movement while grounded. ControlMixin returns true from Player.isImmobile while roll>0; no blanket attack/use-item veto is inferred. On transition positive->0, horizontal speed becomes MOVEMENT_SPEED, retainsY, and clears forced pose only if still CROUCHING. Native terrain/collision and aerial behavior remain; no additional Stage multiplier.

effects.display_name: Dodge Roll damage/effect and explicit GlacialShove admission
effects.human_summary: Dodge Roll damage/effect and explicit GlacialShove admission; static native semantics, runtime untested.
effects.stage_reason: Fixed native resource/control/admission; no numeric HP/SHP payload to scale.
actual_behavior: RollAttachment.preDamage default SubscribeEvent: Player and isInvulnerable -> setCanceled(true), with no DamageType/tag/attacker/amount exception. Exact installed NeoForge CommonHooks posts LivingIncomingDamageEvent and returns isCanceled; LivingEntity.hurt returns false on cancellation before shield handling, armor/Resistance/final damage and ordinary HP effects. Earlier isInvulnerableTo/client/dead/fireResistance rejects still happen before this hook. Retain event ordering and other listeners; no blanket runtime claim against custom direct HP/SHP edits or nonstandard callbacks.

preEffect applies to Player and same roll>7 window, sets Applicable.Result.DO_NOT_APPLY without filtering harmful/beneficial/source/duration. Installed addEffect and forceAddEffect call CommonHooks.canMobEffectBeApplied; event getApplicationResult returns true for APPLY, native canBeAffected only for DEFAULT, false for DO_NOT_APPLY. This rejects application/refresh through those paths, not removal or cleansing existing effects and not arbitrary instant-effect functions/healing. Later event listeners can change final result; Tensura/L2 ordering remains future runtime work.

Native ProjectileImpactEvent constructor accepts Projectile and calls EntityEvent(projectile); inherited getEntity returns that projectile. EventHooks.onProjectileImpact constructs precisely this event. RollAttachment.preImpact tests event.getEntity instanceof Player, not EntityHitResult target. Player cannot also be Projectile, so this branch cannot cancel ordinary native projectile impacts. Do not promote it as projectile deflection/impact immunity. Damage/effect cancellation may still reject later callbacks, while independent explosions, motion, summons, discard or hurt-ignored callbacks can proceed; each payload family must retain its native return dependencies.

effects.display_name: Shared native boss damage
effects.human_summary: Shared native boss damage; static native semantics, runtime untested.
effects.single_scaling_point: Once at final target.hurt amount after damageScale * ATTACK_DAMAGE and EnchantmentHelper.modifyDamage.
effects.stage_reason: Native control/source/part/death choreography; no additional scalable amount.
actual_behavior: attackEntity(target,damageScale) selects native mobAttack(this), whose direct and causing entities are the boss. Explicit-source overload retains caller-supplied DamageSource unchanged. damageScale<=0 returns false before damage. Otherwise requested damage = damageScale * current ATTACK_DAMAGE; on ServerLevel EnchantmentHelper.modifyDamage uses getWeaponItem,target,same source,amount before target.hurt. Hurtfalse returns false; hurttrue runs native server post-attack enchantments, records lastHurtMob, returns true. No hardcoded universal damage amount, no source substitution and no owner-to-player rewrite. Single numeric Stage point is final helper hurt argument after native attribute/enchantment formula; never multiply both attribute and helper or concrete caller and helper.

meleeAttack uses LivingEntity query in AABB.ofSize(position+getLookOffset(reach),aabbSize,aabbSize,aabbSize), excluding self. Default offset height1.5; size is full side length, not radius. Shared helper adds no LOS, team/owner, attackable, current-target-only or native TargetingConditions predicate; callers may choose their own predicates separately. For each selected entity, attackEntity success is required before raw outward normalized horizontal push*pushForce (Y=.2) and consumer callback. Hurtfalse prevents both these followups. Caller-specific damageScale, box, timing and callbacks remain next; no geometric inflation/eligibility repair.

Knight server tick executes attacks only outside animation transition. Its MeleeAttackGoal.canPerformAttack override returnsfalse, so no extra ordinary AI melee is invented for the boss. Actual producers are tick melee/SwordWave/Rift plus jumpSlash->SoulShockwave. attackCombo1 is genuinely called; older attackJumpspin1 has zero installed invocation callers, so its17.5base shockwave is excluded. SoulShockwave static convenience shoot overloads have no external native static callers; do not invent a player delivery. SwordWave also has a real KnightSwordItem.releaseUsing producer, reserved for equipment review using this payload contract.

All native boss melee uses protected shared helper: final damageScale*ATTACK_DAMAGE then native enchantment damage, mob_attack boss/boss, hurttrue required for outward push and consumer. Real variants(full box side,forward reach,push,scale): intro timer28/light1timer10/light2timer18=(6,7,1.5,1) plus getOutOfMe(7,0,1,1); heavy23=(5,7,2.5,1) plus getOutOfMe; light-heavy8=(6,7,1.5,1),37=(5,7,2.5,1), eachplusgetOutOfMe. Combo2 timers38/79/118=(14,2.5,1.5,1),98/125=(6,2.5,1.5,1). Thrust timers46..60=(4,9,.2,.5); native block clearing requires mobGriefing and destroySpeed>0<50, no extra blast. Recovery knocked_down_to_idle timer20=(10,0,3.5,.1). One final helper multiplier, no Stage on boxes/counts/push or attack attributes.

Server handleAttackDamage dispatches claw timer43 range6 scale.834, bite25 range7 scale.667, tail32 range8 scale1, each arc argument120. dealMeleeAttackDamage queries Players in Dragon BB.inflate(range), excludes spectator/creative, requires Euclidean position distance<=range and actual yaw expression abs(degrees(atan2(toPlayer.z,toPlayer.x)-radians(yRot))), if>180 replaced by360-difference, <=120. Preserve this expression, do not reinterpret as a conventional centered half-angle cone. No LOS check. Shared attackEntity requests current ATTACK_DAMAGE*scale, then enchantment modification, mob_attack direct/causing Dragon. Returned boolean is ignored here: raw player.push(normalized full toPlayer vector X/Z*1.2,Y.4) follows even rejected HP. Stage once at final shared hurt amount, never scale attribute and helper both. Ground/flight_dash motion itself has no separate hurt producer.

Yeti uses server tick state callbacks; its chase goal only navigates. Frame = timer - 2. SWIPE_1 frame21 and SWIPE_2 frame28 query a Living box of full side8 at yaw-forward2.5/Y2; they set frozen160, reset invulnerableTime=0, request shared attack scale.8, then displace victims. PUNCH frame18 uses side8 forward2.5/Y1.5, frozen320, iframe reset and scale.8. GROUND_SMASH frame19 uses side8 forward3/Y1.5, frozen320, iframe reset and scale1.2. LEAP_SMASH elapsed50 (countdown20) uses side4 at Y+2, frozen320 and scale1 WITHOUT an iframe reset. Selection excludes only this Yeti: no canFreeze, LOS, team or creative filter. Source is mob_attack, direct and causing entity Yeti; shared helper computes current ATTACK_DAMAGE*scale then native enchantment modification. Scale only its final hurt amount.

DIVE_START timer9 uses anchor parts0->3, maxDistance2, scale.8. At>=30 hides, clears underground effects and performs terrain-selected dive teleport; hidden movement can teleport to target at distanceSquared<4, then snaps to ground. Warning lasts5 while hidden; emergence unhides onStart, timer3 strikes vertical posY-2->+4, maxDistance1.5, scale1.5, then independent upward1.6*modifier push. BITE timer33 of state60 uses three lines anchors0->2,2->5,5->8, maxDistance2, scale1; independently adds POISON amplifier1 duration int(modifier*200) and horizontal outward1.5*modifier push. EARTHQUAKE_SLAM_EMERGE timer22 of70 strikes vertical posY0->+2 maxDistance1.5 scale.25. EARTHQUAKE_SLAM timers28/85/127/151 of176 strikes body12_fx->body16_fx maxDistance8 scale1, independently emitting columns. No hurt-return gate on bite poison, pushes or column emission. Damage cancellation need not cancel these controls/effects.

attackCollidingEntities collects Living targets in each line AABB inflated(maxDistance+2), excludes self and creative/spectator, with no team or LOS check. Projects victim box center onto each finite line. Modifier=1-max((distanceFromLine-2)/maxDistance,0); only positive values, at most1. Each invocation deduplicates by victim and keeps greatest modifier across lines. First SpatialUtil push uses direction*maxDistance*modifier with projection limit2, then shared attackEntity(maxDamageScale*modifier) requests mob_attack based on ATTACK_DAMAGE and native enchantment modification. Boolean is ignored and optional effect/control callback always follows. Scale only the final native hurt amount once, never both parent/helper or raw attribute. Ordinary body contact selects greatest part overlap, then pushes server nonplayers or client players via XOR side predicate, projection limit.3; no HP payload from passive contact.

Flying-tick callback after super queries ALL entities in center box inflated.5 (full side1), excludes only BlazingFireBallEntity and calls igniteForSeconds3, no owner/LOS/hurt/impact-event gate. actual_behavior: InfernalDragonEntity.hurt first delegates BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY unchanged. Remaining phase0 hits multiply amount by2 only when DamageSource.getEntity() (CAUSING entity) instanceof Projectile; then every phase divides by2 if that causing entity is IceSpikeProjectileEntity. Finally original source enters inherited hurt. No getDirectEntity test. Owned native arrows and owned Ice Spike indirect_magic have their Living owner as cause, so neither modifier follows merely from projectile delivery. Ownerless Ice Spike onHitEntity explicitly falls back to itself as cause: phase0 x2 then /2 nets1; other admitted phases /2. canFreeze=false, fireImmune=true, isPushable=false, causeFallDamage=false, knockback resistance1. Default phase0 and legacy counters0; positive counter guards are code contracts, not proof that normal native Dragon hits set them.

Native BossSpawner callback with resolved wall position establishes HadSpawner=true, phase-1, intro230 and cinematic effects230; closes arena exit and anchors wall position. At HP ratio<=.85 phase0 enters1 (wall variant knocked_down90, relocate to spawner, cinematic90); this earlier return shadows its later .5/.25 branches. Phase1 without spawner advances2 immediately; with spawner waits knocked-down timer. Phase2 <=.5 enters3 (its later .25 test is shadowed). Ground/flight/circle pools change delivery position and cadence, not source identity. Native setState remaps names containing flight/fire/wall to idle while doAttack retains attack/head state; actual handleAttackDamage has only attack!=null, not an isCinematic/isDeath guard. Include retained-attack-at-transition fixture rather than assuming all attacks cease in cinematics. Shared timer completion is strictly >duration.

ThrownCrate is native Projectile with gravity.05, drag.99 or.6 in water, swept COLLIDER/Fluid.NONE block ray plus eligible entity collision. Player-owner PvP rule, Neo ProjectileImpact veto and native hitTargetOrDeflectSelf precede hit callbacks. onHitEntity ignores every KrakenTentacleEntity and its part, doing no hit damage/explosion/discard for those results. Other entity result: unless exact owner, requests ownerless magic2; hurttrue and server gates enchantment post callback. Independently server explodes radius1.5/firefalse/MOB, drops2 Cannonball items and discards, even when hurtfalse or owner-equality prevented direct damage. Block impact also explodes/drops/discards. Dropped ammunition is combat supply, not another HP effect. Ordinary projectile ownership rejection may preclude owner hit, but callback semantics are preserved rather than fabricating that test.

Native Explosion resolves indirect source from Projectile owner when it is Living. DamageSources.explosion selects player_explosion whenever BOTH direct and causing entities are nonnull, regardless of whether causing entity is a Player. Therefore native crate explosion is normally direct crate/causing tentacle/player_explosion; cannon explosion is direct cannonball/causing Player/player_explosion. When owner is genuinely unresolved/nonliving it becomes explosion with null causing entity. The exact EXPLOSION-only branch in Cannonball.hasCausedDamage therefore does NOT match normal player-fired cannon splash. Its custom impact still gets native Kraken/tentacle5 multiplier. Owned crate explosion also is not cannon damage. Do not re-label source to make a presumed weakness work. Both explosion types carry is_explosion/no_knockback, bypass neither armor nor shield, and retain normal event/Resistance/protection rules.

Crate radius1.5 and cannon radius2 use native MOB explosion admission, start/detonate hooks, exposure/block occlusion and difficulty. For damage diameter=2*radius, impact=(1-distance/diameter)*exposure; native requested HP=int((impact*impact+impact)/2*7*diameter+1) when native calculator permits, rather than a fixed projectile amount. Radius/exposure also determine affected entities and motion; future Stage must scale only each final HP request, not radius or exposure. Native explosion impulse is separate from hurt result and normal no_knockback tag, with native blast/knockback reduction and player motion handling. MOB block interaction follows griefing rules; keep it native. Veto of direct impact HP is not veto of explosion. Two HP channels may meet native cooldown/iframes; no promise that nominal amounts add at runtime.

Cannonball shares swept projectile/PvP/Neo-impact/deflection handling with crate. Special findHitEntity first searches nearest Kraken within16 using noncombat targeting/ignoreLineOfSight; if projectile currently overlaps that Kraken box it returns Kraken entity hit, otherwise ordinary swept predicate. This is not an unconditional16-range hit and hidden0x0/source admission remain relevant. onHitEntity exact-owner result skips custom hurt AND explosion/discard. Other target requests custom cannonball_hit10 direct ball/causing owner; hurttrue server gates enchantment post; independent radius2 MOB explosion then discard even if hurtfalse. Block hit only explosion/discard. No speed*base arrow damage here. Stage final custom10 and explosion HP separately, exactly once per native request.

Creates real BlazingFireBallEntity owner wearerPlayer, baseDamage1, silent, eyesY-.1, aimed at cause.position plus independent[-.5,.5) jitter, speed1.5/inaccuracy3; insertion result ignored. Reviewed native arrow direct HP, independent hit FireArea, block radius2 NONE explosion, proximity ignition and later burning are reused unchanged. The retaliating owner is defender, not original shooter. Multiple native projectile hits require independent random trials; no fabricated positive control.

onPlayerHurt is LivingDamageEvent.Post for ServerPlayer. Checks exact equipped boots first then chest. No event amount>0, source-is-fall, cooldown or recursive guard in handler. Patched Player.actuallyHurt invokes Post after the f1!=0 HP-change block, so reaching this native event does not require positive HP loss (e.g. full absorption); incoming cancellation/invulnerability can prevent reaching it. Do not turn a synthetic event into a delivered path. Native runtime fixtures must use genuine admitted incoming hits and record actual Post/result ordering.

Boots require fallDistance>=3 and max(knownMovement dot down, deltaMovement dot down)>=.5. Radius clamps that downward speed to[0,4.5]. Calls level.explode(player,playerPosition,radius,NONE), then immediately Explosion.explode() on the returned SAME object. Pinned Level final overload constructs explosion, checks Neo onExplosionStart, normally invokes explode then finalizeExplosion; ServerLevel returns it after packet handling. Thus normally two damage/detonate/control passes, one finalization. If Neo start cancels the first pass, Level returns the same object and mod still invokes explode explicitly once; no second start check. Every actual Explosion.explode still calls native detonate, calculator/exposure, hurt and impulse logic. This is an existing native cancellation inconsistency, not a proposed bypass. Source is player_explosion with direct/causing wearer; NONE keeps blocks and fire flag isfalse. Native hurt cooldowns/geometry may suppress repeat HP: do not assert doubled HP. Future Stage belongs once at each actual explosion per-victim hurt request, never radius or two hook layers. Existing native control impulse remains independent from hurt success. Multiple equipped victims can enter their own native Post handlers; preserve this test case without adding recursion or runtime tests now.

effects.single_scaling_point: IceSpikeProjectileEntity.onHitEntity final ceil/clamp speed*baseDamage hurt argument.
effects.stage_reason: Final native outgoing HP request only; keep amount source/admission and resource/control independent.
actual_behavior: THROW_SPIKE frame25 requires a target. Calm emits one native IceSpikeProjectile with baseDamage=int(attack*.2); enraged emits three at yaw-20/0/+20 with int(attack*.3). Speed4, inaccuracy0, ownerYeti, knockback8, silent. It extends Projectile, not AbstractArrow. Swept hit uses indirect_magic, direct=self, causing=owner or self fallback, amount ceil(clamp(speed*baseDamage,0,INT_MAX)). Owner Living lastHurtMob is set before hurt. On hurt true, non-Enderman Living gets knockback scaled by max(0,1-KBresistance)*knockback*.6 in XZ and Y.1, plus Slowness60 amplifier1. OwnerYeti hitting a Player at distance10..20 requests RANGED_CONTROL. Then breakIce discards; hurt false also breaks and restores previous fire ticks; hurt-true Enderman returns before those callbacks. A natively burning projectile attempts5-second ignition before damage and restores it on failure. Tick preserves collider ray, expanded-BB1 native canHitEntity/owner/vehicle admission, PvP, Neo ProjectileImpact veto and native deflection. Block impact breaks. Drag.99 (.6 water), gravity.05. Base damage and owner persist; custom knockback resets0 on reload. Static shoot helpers have no external native invokestatic callers. Gauntlet constructor producer remains equipment review. Scale final ceil hurt only.

Native cluster interact with gauntlet and free random slot0..3 starts real use, stores UUID, replaces break resource with slot index, sets held and owner player. useOn searches cluster centers near clicked position in full-side3 box and delegates first successful interaction; client only predicts success. Post PlayerTick attachment clears UUIDs whose loaded entity is not Cluster. With at least one valid shard and continued exact gauntlet use, it can collect additional unheld clusters from full-side3x2x3 box one block ahead of eye until4 slots. It does not consume durability or apply a cooldown there. When no longer using that gauntlet, every>=2 game ticks releases the first valid stored cluster: new native IceSpikeProjectile owner player at eye, speed4, inaccuracy=slotIndex*5, baseDamage4, knockback8; then discards cluster, clears UUID and updates lastShot even if addFreshEntity failed. Projectiles preserve R2i5b swept indirect_magic ceil(speed*base) and genuine playerTouch FREEZE8 as different routes. No extra HP added by attachment. Held clusters can release held-state separately when player stops use; native tick ordering/removal matters. Attachment active/shard UUIDs/last_shot persist; missing entities clear naturally.

effects.display_name: Sandworm multipart damage and retaliation resource
effects.human_summary: Sandworm multipart damage and retaliation resource; static native semantics, runtime untested.
effects.stage_reason: Native admission/resources, incoming modifier, scripted defeat, effect delivery or control; no additional scalable HP request here.
actual_behavior: Sixteen native parts use server animation bone positions; part0 dimensions4.5x4.5, others4x4. Parent ordinary hurt rejects client and routes to part1. Part hurt forwards original source to parent and does not apply a second HP pipeline. Sandworm part overload first multiplies incoming amount by1.3 if that segment bit is damaged, rejects result<.01, then invokes inherited hurt through reallyHurt. Only a true result accumulates max(previousHP-currentHP,0) into one GLOBAL recentDamage resource, not one per segment. At>=25 it damages the currently hit segment and resets resource0; otherwise sets reset timer60. Server timer expiry clears the resource. Threshold uses actual net HP loss, including shared lethal restoration. Already-damaged segments can consume another25 threshold; no extra armor stack. Incoming reduction/bonus/resource are native defenses, never a second Stage multiplier.

After successful inherited hurt and segment update, damaged current segment plus source.isDirect plus absence of BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY launches spit from that part toward source.directEntity. DamageSource.isDirect means causingEntity==directEntity, including null==null; it is NOT a physical DamageType test and does not require a Living attacker. Thus an admitted ownerless environmental source can launch untargeted retaliation. A normal owned arrow has different direct/causing entities and fails this condition. A hit that first breaks a segment can immediately retaliate. Hurt false does neither accumulation nor retaliation. Preserve source identity and native event ordering.

Player target starts fight: stack is dive_start, earthquake_approach, intro in execution order. Intro unhides, clears underground effects, sets phase0; each tick through200 reapplies configured attributes but does not refill HP. chooseAttackState uses actual current HP ratio: first unused75%, then50%, then25% gate; one selection per call. Otherwise nearby target within8+random*8 chooses40% screech/60% dive, or weighted phase pool by int(ratio*4). No HP threshold clamps or healing. Shared AbstractStateBoss lethal restoration runs after normal actual damage/Post and excludes BYPASSES_INVULNERABILITY. This terminal request is scripted, not a scalable combat payload; normal native rejection/mitigation remains relevant.

Native StateGoal ticks the controller every AI tick. ActiveState starts timer-1, increments then runs onStart at0 and onTick. onTickFor calls its callback before ending at timer>=limit; endAfter ends at>=limit. Stack push adds first; StateSequence pushes its next child and ticks it immediately. Controller ends an END result only when the original state is still first. This proves real attack delivery without invoking helpers directly. Server animation positions feed multipart boxes and attack bone lines. Intro, warnings, camera shake and death particles carry no extra damage. Patrol dive/emerge can also execute the same native strike callbacks before phase0; they are not silently treated as combat-phase-only.

Cannon candidate creates a tentacle, chooses nearest Cannon within its BB.inflate32 that has no tentacle first passenger, and must successfully ride it; failure discards it and falls back to melee. That method is a geometry predicate, not a block ray: same level, offset from tentacleY+7, absY<3, squared distance<=FOLLOW_RANGE^2(default24), yaw deviation<=targetRotationRange*factor. Heavy configured duration100/look20/hit40 becomes50/10/20 goal ticks; light75/20/36 becomes38/10/18; crate250/130 becomes125/65; runaway154/114 becomes77/57. Mob scheduler ordinarily ticks these every other server AI tick; report goal ticks, not guaranteed wall-time with unloaded/interrupted AI. Melee canContinue checks only timer, so losing target/knockdown after start does not cancel callback automatically. Crate additionally needs cached live target. Noninterruptible goals share MOVE/LOOK flags.

Light plane uses horizontal reach4, halfwidth2 and forward FOLLOW_RANGE; AABB from tentacleY+4 toY+10 inflated horizontally2. Victim position signed lateral distance must<=2; distanceModifier=(2-distance)/2. Heavy uses five colliders with (distance,side,size)=(1.05,.1,.4),(.6,.5,.4),(.9,.4,.4),(1.05,-.2,.4),(1.05,-.4,.2), scaled18*entityScale, Ycenter+7 and height6; left mirrors side offsets. It deduplicates each victim across boxes, keeps greatest modifier, combines impulse via cross product of normalized old/new vectors times average lengths (not simple addition). Targets are Living excluding all KrakenEntity/KrakenTentacleEntity and creative/spectator; no team or block LOS predicate at hit. Custom smash source direct tentacle, causing resolved Ownable owner (normally Kraken); amount=ATTACK_DAMAGE*maxDamageScale*clamp(modifier,.5,1), heavy1/light.5. Edge contact can still deal half-scale even when raw impulse modifier0. Hurt result ignored; Spatial push with projection limit1.5 follows independently. No enchantment post callback. Damage type bypasses armor/shield and suppresses normal damage knockback; independent Spatial push remains. Stage once at final native hurt, preserving original source.

actual_behavior: SandwormGauntlet extends Item, durability1000, use duration72000/BOW. Crouching on top face in onItemUseFirst sets operation mode earthquake; ordinary use defaults missing mode to poison_barrage, applies its modifiers, starts using and consumes interaction. Earthquake adds MOVEMENT_SPEED and JUMP_STRENGTH negative-infinity ADD_VALUE modifiers keyed freeze, ANY equipment group. Poison mode adds MOVEMENT_SPEED +.5 ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE under a key named slow: code is a positive base-speed modifier, do not infer a slow from its label. release or dropping clears operation mode and removes these two modifier IDs. Native attribute clamping/use lifecycle must be retained; they are control/resources with no Stage multiplier.

Server onUseTick in earthquake mode: at useTick30 and every20 thereafter, first costs10 durability via native hurtAndBreak, then chooses up to4 random Living targets other than user in full-side28x8x28 box with strict3<distance<14. No explicit ally/LOS/creative/spectator predicate at candidate selection. Remaining positions use random horizontal radius[3,14). Four native spawnSandColumn attempts pass delay0 and owner user; protected terrain COLLIDER ray may reject each. Column actual victim admission still checks alive, virtual invulnerable, owner and alliance, with push before ally HP rejection. Normal owned payload indirect_magic5 direct column/causing user; unresolved owner magic5 remains native. Cost/count/delay are not Stage values; only final native column HP once.

On release in poison mode compute count=clamp(Java integer (useTick+4)/10,0,4), requiring>=1; earliest count1 at6 held ticks, then2/3/4 at16/26/36. Force=clamp(.5+(useTick-7)/5,.5,1), speed=force*1.5 (.75..1.5), inaccuracy8+count*5. Server directly constructs count PoisonSpitPr at eye with firing ItemStack, sets owner user, silent, baseDamage6 and knockback5, then calls inherited instance shoot along view. It does NOT call the static convenience helpers. No native barrage durability deduction or item cooldown in this method; item-use stat increments for Player. AbstractArrow native speed/base/enchantment HP, return-gated projectile knockback and independent impact PoisonArea use R2i6. Area has no owner transfer, so later native poison tick still has no attacker. Keep each stage point downstream; do not scale count or base6 in addition to HP.

actual_behavior: KrakenTridentItem extends native TridentItem; registry durability2500, ordinary melee attackDamage+9/attackSpeed-2.9. Class factory capability is not promoted as a delivered dispenser path; do not invoke it manually to claim a native positive control. Direct counter writes bypass the duration helper/attribute, but later native on_fire HP still respects native admission. Reuse proven-origin native burning Stage point, never fire duration.
